svg.title: The content model
svg.desc: Twenty three tables, grouped by what they are for. Fields shown are the ones another part of the system depends on, not every column. Relationship labels read from the left card to the right one.
svg.text: Twenty three tables, grouped by what they are for. Fields shown are the ones another part of the system depends on, not every column. Relationship labels read from the left
Browser holds the publishable key only. Every read passes row level security.
Every privileged write goes through /api with the service role, or a security definer function gated on private.has_role().
Prices, totals and stock are recomputed in the database. The browser sends ids and quantities, never money.
